title: Read in Norwegian, keep English nearby
summary: Aligned bilingual pairs are ordinary content blocks, reusable in any project.

blocks.title: A few sentences for the reader

children.no: Jeg vil samle notatene mine på ett sted.
children.en: I want to collect my notes in one place.
children.hint: samle = collect; på ett sted = in one place

children.no: Kan du forklare sammenhengen mellom disse begrepene?
children.en: Can you explain the connection between these concepts?

children.no: Jeg kommer tilbake til denne siden senere.
children.en: I will come back to this page later.

children.no: La meg tenke litt før jeg svarer.
children.en: Let me think a little before I answer.

blocks.question: What changes when you hide English?
blocks.answer: Only the English display in this view changes. The source text remains stored. Export and print use their own explicit language settings.

blocks.text: Open **Parallel** to emphasize the aligned pairs. On a narrow screen, each pair stacks Norwegian above English. The two parts still belong to the same block, and the English toggle applies only to this view.
